name: Absorbing Witchwyrd
text: You can absorb more magic. You can use your magic-absorbing reaction twice per day instead of once.

name: Acid Quake Fonqugon
text: Exposure to acid spewing from tectonic shifts has made you attuned to the ground. You gain imprecise tremorsense with a range of 15 feet and acid resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).

name: Agile Dragonet
text: Your wing control is exceptional. Your fly speed increases to 30 feet and you don't need to land after flying.

name: Aiuvarin
text:
One of your parents was an elf, leaving a clear mark on your features. You gain low-light vision (or darkvision if you already had low-light vision) and the elf trait, and you can select elf, half-elf, and ancestry feats whenever you gain an ancestry feat.

Pathfinder 2e versatile heritage — not part of Starfinder 2e; check with your GM.

name: Akitonian Kasatha
text: You or an ancestor traveled to the Pact Worlds and settled on Akiton. You gain the Quick Jump feat and don't treat sand as uneven ground.

name: Akitonian Nomad Shobhad
text: You were born on Akiton to a clan that traveled far and wide. Akiton's lower gravity gave you skills in leaping that translate well to space combat. You gain the Quick Jump skill feat and don't treat ice or sand as uneven ground.

name: Akitonian Ysoki
text: You or your ancestors grew up on Akiton, scrapping crashed starships or combing junk heaps for treasures. Gain training in Crafting and use Crafting instead of Thievery to Disable a Device. If already trained, gain the Quick Repair general feat instead.

name: Ambassador Brenneri
text: You excelled in your teenage mediation training and were selected to be a member of the famed ambassador corps. You become trained in Diplomacy. You and your ambassador partner gain the Pardon Me action.

name: Ambassador Formian
text: Trained in the tradition of the ancient formian ambassadors who unified the Colonies. You become trained in Society and gain the Multilingual skill feat to further communication across cultures.

name: Amber Dragon
text:
You are an amber dragon, descended from a line of notorious gossips and information brokers. Amber dragons are a member of the new wild dragon family. You can gossip and gather information at breakneck speed. You gain the trained proficiency in a skill of your choice (Diplomacy, or a different skill if you were already trained in Diplomacy), and you gain the Hobnobber skill feat as a bonus skill feat.

Your associated damage type is electricity (a puff of piezoelectric sand), your breath shape is a cone, and your additional unarmed attacks are tail and wing. You can choose Charisma instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are arcane.

name: Ancestor's Armor Osharu
text: You've undergone the extensive process to develop scaled armplates like your ancestors. Your armplates function as commercial dermal plating, are a permanent part of your body, and can have armor runes etched onto them.

name: Ancient Izalguun
text: You're an izalguun who recently emerged from stasis from an earlier evolutionary stage. Your middle limbs are thinner and you have increased dexterity with your arms. You become trained in Crafting and gain the Quick Repair skill feat.

name: Apocalypse Dragon
text:
You are an apocalypse dragon, descended from a line of despoilers and destroyers. You are resistant to the pestilent plagues that your kin can unleash. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against diseases and effects that cause the sickened condition. Each of your successful saving throws against a disease affliction reduces its stage by 2, or by 1 for a virulent disease. Each critical success against an ongoing disease reduces its stage by 3, or by 2 for a virulent disease.

Your associated damage type is cold, your breath shape is a cone, and your additional unarmed attacks are horn and tail. You can choose Constitution instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are divine.

name: Apostae Delver Orc
text: You hail from the hollow planet Apostae. You gain the Additional Lore feat for Apostae Lore. Once per day, if you fail a saving throw against a trap, you can immediately reroll the save as a fortune effect.

name: Aquazoan Astrazoan
text: Astrazoans in aquatic settings develop gills and fins, gaining a 20-foot swim speed and the amphibious trait to breathe in water and air.

name: Artificial Scion Android
text: Your body was created by artificial intelligence to interface with machines. You have android physiology with uncanny details marking non-standard origins. You gain training in Computers and the Phreaker skill feat.

name: Asanan Elf
text: Your ancestors left the elven homeland for the jungles of Asana on Castrovel. You can communicate mentally with creatures within 30 feet that share a language with you, without gaining any access to their thoughts.

name: Ascendant Psychic Lashunta
text: Increase the range of your limited telepathy to 120 feet. If your class grants you spellcasting, innate spells from ancestry feats use the tradition, key attribute modifier, and DCs granted by your class.

name: Assimilated Astrazoan
text: You have completely assimilated to another ancestry. Choose a common ancestry to select feats from, in addition to your own ancestry feats.

name: Assimilating Nuar
text: Blending with the peoples of the Pact Worlds, you gain a general feat and one of that ancestry's native languages as a bonus language.

name: Asteroid Hopper Sarcesian
text: You spend a lot of time in the void of space. You can maintain suspended respiration for up to 4 hours at a time, rather than the usual 1 hour.

name: Astral Dragon
text:
You are an astral dragon, descended from a line of proud psychic dragons from the Astral Plane. You gain the astral trait. You gain the Draconic Resistance feat as a bonus feat.

Your associated damage type is mental, your breath shape is a line, and your additional unarmed attacks are tail and horn. You can choose Intelligence instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are occult.

You gain mental resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).

name: Azrinaran Elf
text: You're an azrinaran elf from the small metal planetoid of Apostae. For generations, your family has lived divorced from any planet's natural environments. You're accustomed to Apostae's synthetic darkness and gain darkvision.

name: Bioluminescent Brenneri
text: You descend from cave-dwelling brenneri in the lightless Jobuwa Chasms. Your specialized fur absorbs fluorescent algae light, allowing you to glow as a warning signal, shedding bright light 20 feet and dim light beyond.

name: Biotech Android
text: Plant grafts, living organs, and alien parts supplement the synthetic parts of your body. You don't gain the attribute flaw to Charisma but instead gain a flaw to Constitution. You become trained in Nature and gain the Train Animal skill feat.

name: Black Dragon
text:
You are a black dragon, descended from a line of loners with mean streaks who rule the swamps. You gain a swim Speed of 10 feet and the amphibious trait. Like all creatures with the amphibious trait, you can breathe both water and air.

Your associated damage type is acid, your breath shape is a line, and your additional unarmed attacks are tail and horn. You can choose Wisdom instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are arcane.

name: Black Hole Novian
text: Your progenitor star collapsed into a black hole, as have you. You don't shed light and lose the Solar Luminance ability. You gain darkvision and the Absorb Light action.

name: Bliss Dragon
text:
You are a bliss dragon, descended from a line of serene healers. You can add the nonlethal trait to your unarmed attacks from the dragon ancestry, as well as your breath weapon from the dragon ancestry; you make this choice each time you use them, and you take no penalty regardless of which you choose.

Your associated damage type is electricity, your breath shape is a line, and your additional unarmed attacks are horn and tail. You can choose Charisma instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are divine.

name: Bloodfilter Orocoran
text: Your blood filters dangerous chemicals and toxins from your bloodstream. You gain the Fast Recovery general feat and the Siphon Poison ability.

name: Bloom-Born Kalo
text: You grew up near a bloom, a naturally occurring portal to the First World. You gain training in Nature and can cast Detect Magic as a primal innate cantrip at will, heightened to half your level.

name: Blue Dragon
text:
You are a blue dragon, descended from a line of poised cosmopolitan manipulators who seize power through webs of conspiracy. You gain the Draconic Resistance feat as a bonus feat.

Your associated damage type is electricity, your breath shape is a line, and your additional unarmed attacks are tail and horn. You can choose Charisma instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are arcane.

You gain electricity resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).

name: Bone-Cracker Kholo
text: Your bite is devastating. Your jaws Strike upgrades to 1d8 piercing and bypasses resistance on critical hits.

name: Borai
text: You've returned from the brink of death as a borai—at once both living and undead. You gain the borai and undead trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. Unlike other undead, you don't gain void healing. You're healed by vitality effects and damaged by void damage, as if you were a living creature. Likewise, you can be stabilized, healed, and brought back to life as if you were a living creature, save that you always return to life in your normal undead state (as a borai). You gain low-light vision, or you gain darkvision if your ancestry already has low-light vision. You can choose from borai feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.

name: Bouncy Orb Bantrid
text: Your foot orb is surrounded in a layer of bouncy material, like a big rubber ball. You take no fall damage, regardless of the distance you fall.

name: Brass Dragon
text:
You are a brass dragon, descended from a line of independent conversationalists with insatiable curiosity and short attention spans. You gain the Draconic Resistance feat as a bonus feat.

Your associated damage type is fire, your breath shape is a line, and your additional unarmed attack is wing. You can choose Charisma instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are arcane.

You gain fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).

name: Bright Novian
text: You're brilliant, blazing with a light that puts other novians to shame. You shed bright light in a 60-foot radius (dim light for the next 60 feet). You gain the Concentrate Light action.

name: Brightsheen G'folian
text: A layer of scintillating patterns shifts across your shell like a kaleidoscopic oil slick, coming from a history of travel during daytime hours. You gain the Dazzling Shell reaction.

name: Brilliant Mien Ijtikri
text: Your mantle shimmers resplendently in the light. You're trained in Intimidation. While in bright light, you can Demoralize by redirecting light at foes, losing the auditory trait and gaining the visual trait, without penalty for language barriers.

name: Brine Dragon
text:
You are a brine dragon, descended from a line of water elemental dragons obsessed with rigid courtesy and discipline. You gain the elemental and water traits. You still need to breathe, but you also gain the amphibious trait, allowing you to breathe both water and air. You gain a swim Speed of 10 feet, but you can choose to instead gain a swim pace of 25 feet and reduce your land Speed to 10 feet.

Your associated damage type is acid, your breath shape is a line, and your additional unarmed attacks are tail and wing. You can choose Charisma instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are primal.

name: Briskwander Vesk
text: You come from a line of vesk who were constantly on the move. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.

name: Bronze Dragon
text:
You are a bronze dragon, descended from a line of stoic scholars and guardians of lore. You gain a swim Speed of 10 feet and the amphibious trait. Like all creatures with the amphibious trait, you can breathe both water and air.

Your associated damage type is electricity, your breath shape is a line, and your additional unarmed attack is tail. You can choose Intelligence instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are arcane.

name: Builder Formian
text: An architect and builder drawing upon the vast knowledge of your colony for your craft. You become trained in Crafting and gain a formian-specific construction ability.

name: Bulky Nuar
text: You are Large instead of Medium. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DC against attempts to Shove or Trip you, and to saves against effects that would move or knock you down.

name: Bumalla Worlanisi
text: You work at venues entertaining audiences across the stars. You're trained in Performance. If you would automatically become trained in Performance, you become trained in another skill. You gain the Virtuosic Performer skill feat.

name: Burrow-Sworn Vulkarisu
text: Short-tailed and built for deep burrows, you gain darkvision and a burrow Speed of 10 feet. You do not gain the vulkarisu climb Speed or Land on Your Feet.

name: Cackle Kholo
text: Your distinctive laugh unnerves foes. Once per combat, use your cackle to impose frightened 1 on all enemies within 30 feet who can hear you.

name: Canopy Crawler Osharu
text: Osharus from the jungle are lanky and lean with adhesive secretions that make them natural climbers. You become trained in Athletics and gain the Climbing Specialist (25 feet) feat.

name: Caravan Cousin Halfling
text: You spent significant time traveling with a halfling caravan, wheeling and dealing with people from all kinds of worlds. You become trained in Diplomacy, gain the Bargain Hunter feat, and a +1 status bonus to Diplomacy checks to Earn Income.

name: Cataclyst Human
text: You're the child of a dead world or doomed civilization. The circumstance bonus to initiative rolls you gain when you or an ally uses the Scout exploration activity is +2 instead of +1. When you roll initiative, you can Stand or Step as a reaction.

name: Cerulean Dragon
text:
You are a cerulean dragon, descended from a line of explorers and adventurers. Cerulean dragons are a member of the new wild dragon family. You gain a swim Speed of 10 feet and the amphibious trait. Like all creatures with the amphibious trait, you can breathe both water and air.

Your associated damage type is bludgeoning (a wave of water), and all your dragon abilities that deal bludgeoning damage have the water trait. Your breath shape is a cone, and your additional unarmed attacks are tail and wing. You can choose Dexterity instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are arcane.

name: Chemoreceptive Gnarefuroid
text: Sensitive taste cirrisensors give you imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against ingested and olfactory effects, and a success on such a save becomes a critical success.

name: Citadel Dwarf
text: You're part of a renowned mining clan that tunnels into planets, moons, and asteroids for rare minerals. You become trained in Survival. When you critically succeed at a Survival check to Earn Income by mining, you uncover a vein of highly valuable minerals.

name: City-Kin Copaxi
text: You're from one of Tabrid Minor's sprawling megacities. You gain training in a profession-related Lore skill and a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks when making impressions within your profession.

name: Citywrought G'folian
text: Where most g'folian ditties were isolationists, your forebears lived in urban areas. You become trained in Society and gain the Blend In skill feat.

name: Clan Kindred Orc
text: Raised among dwarves, you're a symbol of all that's been lost but also all that's been built anew. You gain the Dwarven Lore feat, learn Dwarven, and gain the Clan Crystal dwarven ancestry feature. You can choose from dwarf and orc feats.

name: Clawed Brenneri
text: A muscular brenneri heritage with pronounced claws suited for combat roles. Grants Athletics training, a +1 bonus to force-open checks, and an ancestral claw unarmed attack feat.

name: Cliff-Climber Lizardfolk
text: You gain a climb speed of 20 feet and can cling to surfaces with no hands free.

name: Clinging Gnarefuroid
text: Adhesive resin and suction appendages improve your climb Speed to 20 feet. You become trained in Athletics (another skill if you would already be trained) and gain the Combat Climber skill feat.

name: Cloned Astrazoan
text: Your body stubbornly refuses additional external attempts to change you. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a curse, disease, or polymorph effect, you get a critical success instead.

name: Cloud Dragon
text:
You are a cloud dragon, descended from a line of inquisitive air elemental dragons who love to wander and explore. You gain the air and elemental traits, though you still need to breathe. Fog and mist don't impair your vision; you ignore the concealed condition from fog and mist.

Your associated damage type is electricity, your breath shape is a cone, and your additional unarmed attacks are tail and horn. You can choose Wisdom instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are primal.

name: Code-Sworn Vulkarisu
text: Descended from those who decoded Triune's Signal, you gain one cantrip from the arcane spell list and can cast it as an innate arcane spell at will, heightened to half your level rounded up.

name: Community-Sworn Vulkarisu
text: An enthusiastic traveler, you become trained in Society (another skill if you would already be trained) and gain your choice of a general feat or a skill feat.

name: Compact Sarcesian
text: You're incredibly flexible and can fold your gangly limbs up and around yourself like a contortionist, enabling you to maneuver in small and awkward spaces.

name: Construct Copycat Astrazoan
text: You have reinforced your body with technological augmentations that can be shifted to give yourself the appearance of a constructed creature.

name: Contract-Sworn Vulkarisu
text: Born to a family under fiendish contract, you become trained in Deception (another skill if you would already be trained).

name: Copper Dragon
text:
You are a copper dragon, descended from a line of wily pranksters and compassionate hedonists. You gain the Draconic Resistance feat as a bonus feat.

Your associated damage type is acid, your breath shape is a line, and your additional unarmed attack is tail. You can choose Charisma instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are arcane.

You gain acid resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).

name: Corpsefolk
text:
Corpsefolk are people who died and reanimated as corporeal, intelligent undead, with the same general appearance and personality they had in life, though usually with sickly pale skin, rotting parts, exposed bone, or other signs of putrescence.

You are a reanimated corpse. Your undead nature might physically manifest in gray or pale skin, eyes that turn solid black or white, or an unnatural elongation of the fingernails (or similar appendages). You gain the corpsefolk and undead traits, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. You gain low-light vision, or you gain darkvision if your ancestry already has low-light vision. You can choose from corpsefolk feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.

Corpsefolk also gain the following.

Immunity to Death Effects: You are immune to death effects, such as being automatically killed or having your dying value increase, but not other parts of the spell or effect (such as damage or becoming frightened from vision of death).

Void Healing: You are damaged by vitality damage and aren't healed by vitality healing effects. You don't take void damage and are healed by void effects that heal undead.

Void Survival: Unlike normal undead, you aren't destroyed when reduced to 0 Hit Points. Instead, powerful energies attempt to keep you from being destroyed. You are knocked out and begin dying when reduced to 0 Hit Points. Because you're undead, many methods of bringing someone back from the dying condition, such as , don't benefit you. When you would die, you're destroyed rather than just dead, just like other undead.

Special: At the GM's discretion, you can select the corpsefolk versatile heritage after 1st level if your character dies and has an opportunity to be raised as an undead. This replaces your heritage.

name: Countershade Crest Ijtikri
text: Your mantle's coloration provides camouflage and excellent buoyancy control. Your swim Speed increases to 20 feet and you gain the amphibious trait, enabling you to breathe in water and air.

name: Court of Dance Moyishuu
text: Your nature is expressed primarily by movement. You become trained in Acrobatics and gain the Crowd Surfing skill feat. Once per day, you can temporarily attune your soulfeel to joy for 1 minute as a free action.

name: Court of Fields Moyishuu
text: Your nature is to enact plans, whether immediate or years-long. You become trained in Diplomacy and gain the Group Impression skill feat. Once per day, you can temporarily attune your soulfeel to wonder for 1 minute.

name: Court of Flames Moyishuu
text: Your nature is to tackle problems immediately and directly, even if it means leaving scorched earth in your wake. You become trained in Intimidation and gain the Quick Coercion skill feat. Once per day, you can attune your soulfeel to fury for 1 minute.

name: Court of Song Moyishuu
text: Your nature is passionately artistic with an intrinsic connection to that ability. You become trained in Performance and gain the Impressive Performance skill feat. Once per day, you can attune your soulfeel to sorrow for 1 minute.

name: Courtier Shirren
text: Your telepathy is stronger than most, allowing you to transmit emotions alongside messages. When a creature communicates with you via limited telepathy, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Sense Motive against them.

name: Covert Observer Barathu
text: You prefer to unobtrusively observe others rather than directly engaging. You become trained in Stealth and gain the Quiet Allies feat. By spending 10 minutes modifying your body's shape and color, you gain a +2 bonus to Stealth in that environment.

name: Creche-Raised Sarcesian
text: You were raised on an idyllic creche world in close quarters with dozens of other sarcesian children. You are trained in Diplomacy and gain the Group Impression skill feat.

name: Crypt Dragon
text:
You are a crypt dragon, descended from a line of soul wardens. Your weapon and unarmed attacks against incorporeal creatures become magical, and if they were already magical, they instead gain the effects of a Ghost Touch property rune.

Your associated damage type is negative, your breath shape is a cone, and your additional unarmed attacks are horn and tail. You can choose Wisdom instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are divine.

name: Crystal Carapace Urog
text: Your crystalline husk is thicker than most. Your shell functions as light armor in the ceramic armor group granting +2 item bonus to AC, Dex Cap +2, check penalty -1, with archaic, comfort, and flexible traits. You can wear a flight suit but not other armor.

name: Crystal Crown Ijtikri
text: Minerals incorporated into your growing mantle linked you to your home environs. You gain the Additional Lore feat for a terrain-related Lore skill. You can also ask questions of and use Diplomacy with animals native to that terrain.

name: Crystal Dragon
text:
You are a crystal dragon, descended from a line of vain but good-hearted earth elemental dragons who love to cultivate beautiful homes. You gain the earth and elemental traits, though you still need to breathe. You also gain a special sense: imprecise tremorsense with a range of 20 feet. This means you can use your tremorsense to attempt to determine the square of a creature in contact with the exact same surface. In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks whenever you're trying to locate an undetected creature that is within the range of your tremorsense.

Your associated damage type is piercing (a spray of piercing crystals), your breath shape is a cone, and your additional unarmed attack is tail. You can choose Charisma instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are primal.

name: Damai Human
text: Descendants of survivors from an apocalypse on Daimalko, damai humans feature gray skin and piercing eyes. They're trained in piloting mechs called valkos and possess limited telepathy within 30 feet with shared language speakers.

name: Damaya Lashunta
text: You've chosen adaptive genetics to become a damaya with a leaner body type for work as a scholar or politician. Gain Intelligence boost and Constitution flaw, trained in Diplomacy, and the Additional Lore feat.

name: Deadwood Khizar
text: You've been rotting on the inside for some time, and the invisible rot has changed you. You have the void healing ability, meaning you're damaged by vitality damage and healed by void effects that heal undead.

name: Deathless Samsaran
text: Your reincarnation cycle fortifies you. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against death effects and never die at negative max HP — instead, you stabilize.

name: Deep Diver Azarketi
text: You suffer no penalties from water pressure and can see clearly in dark water to 60 feet.

name: Deep Kalo
text: You were born deep in the aphotic zone where no light penetrates from the surface. You gain echolocation as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet (60 feet when underwater).

name: Deep Space Hryngar
text: You're a hryngar, one of the subterranean dwarves who rejected the Quest for Sky. You have an attribute bonus to Charisma and a flaw to Wisdom, become trained in Deception, and gain bonuses against those who owe you money or caused financial loss.

name: Deep Ysoki
text: You're accustomed to living in dark places, such as maintenance shafts, asteroids, and on distant moons far from the sun. You gain darkvision.

name: Deepmarsh Osharu
text: Deepmarsh osharus are highly solitary, seeking the ascetic wisdom of the deepest swamps. You become trained in Survival and gain poison resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).

name: Deepswimmer Woioko
text: You thrive in deep water. You can breathe underwater and your swim speed increases to 35 feet.

name: Defiant Shirren
text: You remain resolute in your defiance of the Swarm. If you roll a success on a Will save against an effect from a kucharn or Swarm creature, you get a critical success instead. You also gain the Rebellious Defiance action.

name: Dense Novian
text: Your progenitor star is a superdense neutron star or white dwarf. Like your progenitor, you're incredibly dense, weighing twice as much. Gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude and Reflex DCs against repositioning, shoving, or tripping, and to saves against forced movement.

name: Desert Ikeshti
text: You're accustomed to surviving in the harsh, arid deserts of Akiton. You gain fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1) and heat effects are one step less extreme. You can go without food or water an extra month before starving.

name: Doomsayer Kasatha
text: You're from a Great Family that remained behind on a dying planet to perform final rites. You've developed techniques for both delaying doom and accepting it.

name: Dragon-Scaled Kobold
text: Your scales reflect your draconic heritage. You gain a +1 item bonus to AC and resistance 2 to your patron dragon's energy type.

name: Dream Dragon
text:
You are a dream dragon, descended from a line of masters and guardians of the Dreamlands. You gain the dream trait. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus on saving throws against spells and abilities that specifically affect your dreams, such as nightmare, and if you roll a success on a saving throw against such a spell or ability, you get a critical success instead. If you roll a critical success on your saving throw against such a spell or ability, you gain a vague sense of the identity and location of the entity that attempted to intrude upon your dreams.

Your associated damage type is mental, your breath shape is a cone, and your additional unarmed attacks are tail and horn. You can choose Charisma instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are occult.

name: Dreamer Barathu
text: You've communed with the cosmic melody of Liavara. Choose one cantrip from the occult spell list. You can cast this spell as an occult innate spell at will, heightened to half your level rounded up. Once per day, you can meditate to change the cantrip to a different occult cantrip.

name: Drift Delver Gnome
text: You're drawn to the Drift, the artificial plane created by Triune. You become trained in Piloting, gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Navigate within or through the Drift, and reduce the travel time through the Drift by 1 day.

name: Dromaar
text:
One of your parents was an orc, granting you a powerful build. You gain low-light vision and the orc trait, and you can select orc, half-orc, and ancestry feats whenever you gain an ancestry feat.

Pathfinder 2e versatile heritage — not part of Starfinder 2e; check with your GM.

name: Ductsneak Halfling
text: You've subsisted in forgotten grooves of settlements and starships. You become trained in Acrobatics and gain the Quick Squeeze skill feat. You don't take a penalty for not using a crowbar to force-open panels or grates to enter spaces a Medium creature must squeeze through.

name: Durable Dragonet
text: Despite your size, you're hard to hurt. You gain resistance 2 to the damage type of your breath weapon.

name: Early Stage Barathu
text: Young and inexperienced with an individualistic worldview. Small size, highly mutable form. You gain the Quick Squeeze feat and precision damage resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).

name: Edict Dragon
text:
You are an edict dragon, descended from a line of planners, bringers of order, and purgers of corruption. While your tail isn't prehensile, it is capable of writing simple text and glyphs, and it generates the necessary ink on its own. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on saving throws against fear effects, and if you roll a success against a fear effect, you get a critical success instead.

Your associated damage type is slashing, your breath shape is a line of razor sharp papers and parchments, and your additional unarmed attacks are tail and wing. You can choose Wisdom instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are divine.

name: Electric Kalo
text: You descend from a remote tribe that developed a bioelectric defense against predators. You can cast Electric Arc as a primal innate cantrip at will. If cast with only 1 target, you gain electricity resistance equal to half your level until the end of your next turn.

name: Electronica Android
text: Your body was created to perform live music for the wealthy or assist composers. Over time, music awakened a creative spirit within you. You're an electronica android designed to excel at playing music and communicating complex emotions through sound.

name: Emeritus Trox
text: You've gone through the Leaving and taken on a new name upon deciding to change your life. You're trained in a Recall Knowledge skill of your choice. When you attempt a check in a Lore skill you're untrained in, treat your level as your proficiency bonus.

name: Empathic Vlaka
text: You instinctively sense when the people around you are feeling strong emotions. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to Sense Motive and may secretly notice enchantment or emotion effects on others.

name: Enhoitra Maraquoi
text: You're from the shores of Marata with claws suited for swimming. You don't feel disoriented while floating in water or space. You gain a swim Speed of 25 feet, the Breath Control feat, and aren't Off-Guard while in water or zero gravity.

name: Enshrined Vesk
text: You're the soul of a dead vesk hero preserved inside a living stone statue. You gain the construct trait, don't need to eat, drink, or breathe, and have environmental protections. You need 2 hours of daily meditative rest.

name: Entertainer Elebrian
text: You love being in the spotlight, born and raised in the Halls of the Living. You're trained in Performance and Media Lore, and you gain the Impressive Performance skill feat.

name: Etheric Dragon
text:
You are an etheric dragon, descended from a line of pragmatic survivalists from the Ethereal Plane. You gain the ethereal trait. Your weapon and unarmed attacks against incorporeal creatures become magical, and if they were already magical, they instead gain the effects of a Ghost Touch property rune.

Your associated damage type is force, your breath shape is a line, and your additional unarmed attacks are tail and horn. You can choose Constitution instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are occult.

name: Everwhelp Skittermander
text: Despite being a full-grown adult, you've retained your stomach-mouth. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage in the brawling group with finesse, skittermander, and unarmed traits.

name: Exiled Elebrian
text: You're an elebrian not born on Eox. You learn any regional language of your choice and gain the Additional Lore feat for that region. You gain another language and Additional Lore feat at 5th level, and again at 13th level.

name: Experimental Ikeshti
text: Scientists have experimented on you, leaving a lasting mark. Your augmentation implant limit increases by 1 (only for biotech augmentations). Choose one common biotech augmentation of item level 1 or less — you begin with it implanted at no cost.

name: Faith-Converted Urog
text: You believe the best way to learn about the universe is to go to the gods who created it. You become trained in Religion and gain the Student of the Canon feat. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Learn a Spell.

name: Fidgeter Skittermander
text: You've never been able to sit still, which helps you avoid danger. You gain the Fidget reaction.

name: Field Researcher Urog
text: Your unique biology provides the perfect means to survive the harshest environments. You can Subsist in any atmospheric environment, are never Fatigued from lack of food, and environmental temperature effects are one step less extreme.

name: Fierce Ysoki
text: A fierce variant with a bulkier frame and sharp teeth. Gain Strength boost instead of Dexterity, 8 Hit Points from ancestry, and jaws dealing 1d8 piercing damage with brawling group and grapple and unarmed traits.

name: Fierce-Breath Dragonet
text: Your breath weapon is especially potent. Its damage increases by 1d6 and you can use it once more per day.

name: Fire Flood Fonqugon
text: A hardy fonqugon heritage granting 8 Hit Points from ancestry and fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1), reflecting survival of destructive algae-induced fire floods.

name: Flameheart Dragonkin
text: The embers burning in your blood keep you safe from the chill of high altitudes. You gain resistance to cold equal to half your level (minimum 1) and treat environmental cold as one step less extreme.

name: Fluffy Skittermander
text: Your long, fast-growing fur can be groomed to cool or insulate your body. Your winter coat gives cold resistance and your summer coat gives fire resistance (equal to half your level, minimum 1), one step less extreme environmental effects.

name: Forest Dragon
text:
You are a forest dragon, descended from a line of jealous guardians of nature who loathe technology and civilization. You gain the plant trait. You are much harder to track in forest terrain. While in such terrain, you gain the benefit of a Pass Without Trace spell at all times, using your spell DC or class DC, whichever is higher, to determine the DC.

Your associated damage type is piercing (a swarm of biting insects), your breath shape is a cone, and your additional unarmed attack is tail. You can choose Wisdom instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are primal.

name: Fork-Tongued Vesk
text: Fork-tongued vesk from the Gojori swamps create potent venom. They gain a +1 bonus to saves against disease and poison and a venomous jaws unarmed attack dealing 1d4 poison damage with persistent damage on critical hits.

name: Fortified Trox
text: You bathed in the waters of Gabanon Springs during a molting period, making your exoskeleton denser. Your chitinous plates function as medium armor in the plate armor group granting +4 item bonus to AC with Dex cap +1 and analog, comfort, and exposed traits.

name: Fortunaut Worlanisi
text: You've taken to the stars as a fortunaut, a sentient good luck charm. You're trained in Diplomacy (or another skill if already trained) and gain the Hobnobber skill feat.

name: Frilled Vesk
text: You can deploy colorful neck frills to intimidate rivals. Become trained in Intimidation, gain the Intimidating Glare feat, and treat environmental heat effects as one step less extreme.

name: Fullbright Shirren
text: Raised in shirren colonies, you've adapted to constant work cycles. You need only 6 hours of rest instead of 8, and gain +1 circumstance bonus to saves against drained, enfeebled, or fatigued effects.

name: Gadraveech Skittermander
text: You grew up in the subterranean realm of Gadraveech with wispy, pale-colored fur and large, luminous eyes. You gain darkvision.

name: Galactic Wanderer Barathu
text: You gain the cosmic trait and enhanced flight in zero gravity, reflecting a life spent exploring space and adapting to celestial wonders.

name: Gallant Skittermander
text: A heritage for skittermanders who grew to twice their normal size through frequent conflicts defending others. Gain Strength bonuses instead of Dexterity, become Medium-sized, and receive training in Athletics and the Titan Wrestler feat.

name: Ganzi
text:
The roiling chaos of the Maelstrom shaped your heritage. You gain the ganzi trait, resistance to a randomly varying energy type, and a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against effects that would impose a specific harmful outcome you can reroll.

Pathfinder 2e versatile heritage — not part of Starfinder 2e; check with your GM.

name: Gap-Touched
text: The Gap has subsumed some part of you and left you with weird powers and jarring existential issues, while giving you a unique ability to perceive the history obscured by the Gap. You gain the Gap-touched trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. You can choose from Gap-touched feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat. You gain the general feat for Gap Lore. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against mental effects.

name: Genetic Pioneer Lashunta
text: Auto-experimentation is your craft, and your body is your canvas. Your augmentation limit increases by 2. You become trained in Medicine and can implant augmentations yourself with master proficiency in 10 minutes.

name: Genetically Unstable Barathu
text: Your genetic code has become unstable through decades of modification. You're more transparent than most barathus. You gain the Become Ooze action.

name: Gengen Osharu
text: Gengen osharus adapted to the seawaters of Pabaq's briny seas. You gain a swim Speed of 20 feet and the amphibious trait, enabling you to breathe in water and air.

name: Glacierborn Shobhad
text: You trace your lineage to a shobhad clan that migrates along the Akitonian glaciers. You have cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1) and gain the Combat Climber skill feat.

name: Glowsilk Lashunta
text: Residents of Glowsilk Jungle on Castrovel learn self-sufficiency. Gain training in Survival, the Urban Survivalist feat, and +1 bonus to poison saves (+2 against fungal poison).

name: Golarion Survivor Human
text: Your ancestors lived on Golarion. You become trained in Golarion Lore and learn a bonus language from your lineage's region. You have familiarity with archaic weapons, treating one archaic martial weapon as simple or one advanced as martial.

name: Gold Dragon
text:
You are a gold dragon, descended from a line of wise and powerful counselors and leaders. You gain the Draconic Resistance feat as a bonus feat.

Your associated damage type is fire, your breath shape is a cone, and your additional unarmed attacks are tail and horn. You can choose Wisdom instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are divine.

You gain fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).

name: Gold-Blooded Madrosarai
text: Aurum blood fills your veins, giving your skin a metallic sheen. Associated with leadership and coordination. You become trained in Intimidation and gain the Group Coercion skill feat. On a critical failure to Coerce a humanoid, you get a failure instead.

name: Green Dragon
text:
You are a green dragon, descended from a line of obsessive and meticulous scholars. You gain the Draconic Resistance feat as a bonus feat.

Your associated damage type is poison, your breath shape is a cone, and your additional unarmed attacks are tail and horn. You can choose Intelligence instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are arcane.

You gain poison resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).

name: Green Warden Kasatha
text: You trained aboard the Idari or near friendship oases, gaining expertise in Nature and Life Science. You ignore difficult terrain from brush or undergrowth.

name: Grumpy Skittermander
text: Not all skittermanders are helpful. You're grouchy, gruff, and somber. You become trained in Intimidation and gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat.

name: Ha-Quoia Maraquoi
text: Some maraquois climb skyscrapers rather than kvashes. You're from a large city with alacrity in the digital world. You become trained in Computers, gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Access Infosphere in large settlements, and gain the Hologram Skeptic skill feat.

name: Hardy Leshy
text: Your body is adapted for planets that undergo harsh seasonal shifts. You gain the Toughness feat. Treat environmental cold and heat effects as one step less extreme. You can go without food or water twice as long as typical.

name: Harlequin Dragon
text:
You are a harlequin dragon, descended from a line of clever and insightful jesters. Harlequin dragons are a member of the new wild dragon family. Your jokes and performances contain insights that impress people the more they realize your hidden depths. You gain the trained proficiency in a skill of your choice (Performance, or a different skill if you were already trained in Performance), and you gain the Impressive Performance skill feat as a bonus skill feat.

Your associated damage type is poison (a cloud of poison gas), your breath shape is a cone, and your additional unarmed attacks are tail and wing. You can choose Charisma instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are arcane.

name: Havoc Dragon
text:
You are a havoc dragon, descended from a line of passionate artists who always give it their all but wind up causing trouble. You gain the trained proficiency in a skill of your choice (Performance, or a different skill if you were already trained in Performance), and you gain the Virtuosic Performer skill feat.

Your associated damage type is sonic, your breath shape is a cone, and your additional unarmed attacks are horn and tail. You can choose Charisma instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are divine.

name: Heartbroken Dragonkin
text: Your bonded partner died, and you remain devastated. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against emotion effects. If you succeed on a save against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.

name: Hellforged Android
text: A formidable, armored construction from Hell originally built for the Hellknights. You gain a Strength boost instead of Dexterity and have integrated Hellforged plates as medium armor. You cannot wear other armor or remove these plates, but can etch armor runes onto them.

name: Hollow Leshy
text: Your plant body is hollow, including a large open space in your arms to store objects. You gain the Internal Compartment ability, storing up to 1 Bulk in your body, taking only 1 action to store an object.

name: Hollow Orb Bantrid
text: Your foot orb has a hollow, lattice-like cell structure making it lighter and water-capable. You gain a 20-foot swim Speed and can move atop liquid surfaces at your normal Speed.

name: Horizon Seeker Vesk
text: Your tail functions like an extra hand for holding equipment and performing Interact actions. You gain a climb Speed equal to your land Speed.

name: Hostless Entu Colony
text: You're an entu colony without a host. You gain the Tactical Symbiosis action.

name: Hullborne Gnarefuroid
text: Fused hull plating forms a permanent carapace: +3 item bonus to AC, Dex cap +2, check penalty -2, Strength threshold +2, one upgrade slot. It counts as medium armor in the ceramic group with the analog and comfort traits and can be improved with credits, but you can never wear other armor or remove it.

name: Hunter-Stalker Pahtra
text: You descend from hunters with fur suited to blending into natural environments. In undeveloped settings, gain +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth for Hide and Sneak, and to Survival for Subsist and Cover Tracks.

name: Hylaxian Diplomat Trox
text: Hylax teaches peace above all things, and you use this philosophy as a guiding light. You have the No Cause for Alarm skill feat. Once per day, if you would critically fail a Diplomacy check to make a request, you can reroll it and take the better result (fortune).

name: Hylki Human
text: You're from Akiton, a dusty red planet in the Pact Worlds. Hylki humans tend to be taller and stockier because they grew up in low gravity, with rosy-hued skin. You're trained in Athletics and gain the Quick Jump skill feat.

name: Hyper-Augmented Raxilite
text: Through extensive body modification, you've adjusted your body shape to produce extra space for augmentations. You gain the Augmented Body general feat and can swap augmentations in 3 days of downtime instead of the usual time.

name: Icesure G'folian
text: Your ditty developed in a region of extreme cold near mountains or the polar regions. You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1) and ignore difficult terrain from ice or snow.

name: Imperious Contemplative
text: Your brain rewards you with endorphins whenever you witness your rivals flailing helplessly. You gain the Shielding Arrogance reaction.

name: Indigo Dragon
text:
You are an indigo dragon, descended from a line of partygoing revelers. Indigo dragons are a member of the new wild dragon family. Your antics can quickly make a positive impression on large groups of people. You gain the trained proficiency in a skill of your choice (Diplomacy, or a different skill if you were already trained in Diplomacy), and you gain the Group Impression skill feat as a bonus skill feat.

Your associated damage type is piercing (a cone of thorns and indigo flowers), your breath shape is a cone, and your additional unarmed attacks are tail and wing. You can choose Charisma instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are arcane.

name: Industrial Dwarf
text: Your clan has long honed its trade through technology. You gain the Additional Lore feat for your clan's primary industry. When you Craft a common item associated with this industry, you know the formula automatically and can use the Lore skill in place of Crafting.

name: Industrialist Copaxi
text: An elite copaxi heritage focused on interplanetary business relations. You gain training in Society, an additional language, and the Management Material feat.

name: Infernal Dragon
text:
You are an infernal dragon, descended from a line of tyrannical deal brokers. You keep your deeds out of the spotlight of magical effects meant to learn more about you. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on saving throws against divination effects, and if you roll a success against a divination, you get a critical success instead.

Your associated damage type is fire, your breath shape is a line, and your additional unarmed attacks are horn and tail. You can choose Charisma instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are divine.

name: Inflorescent Khizar
text: You draw from a wellspring of vital energy to remain constantly in bloom. Choose one cantrip: Stabilize or Vitality Lash, which you can cast as a primal innate spell at will. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against void effects.

name: Infogriefer Goblin
text: Goblins sometimes vent pent-up aggression by bothering others online, a behavior called 'gobbing.' You become trained in Computers and gain the Battle Gobbing action.

name: Inheritor Copaxi
text: You've earned the right to call yourself an inheritor of Gadrath, a powerful order of mystics and solarians. You take no falling damage, regardless of distance fallen, as long as you are conscious.

name: Inheritor Raxilite
text: You were influenced by a great hero. Choose a field they excelled in: Bioengineer (Crafting + Specialty Crafting), Daredevil (Diehard), Emissary (Society), Interstellar Pilot (Piloting), Physician (Medicine), or Software Architect (Computers).

name: Inured Ikeshti
text: Your brood consumed poisonous or tainted food, making your body excel at breaking down toxins. You gain poison resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1) and gain the Diehard general feat.

name: Iridescent Shirren
text: Your iridescent chitin creates shimmering patterns that fascinate other creatures. You can Feint at 10 feet range and gain the Shimmering Dazzle action.

name: Ironblood Hobgoblin
text: Military conditioning toughens your body. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves.

name: Irreproachable Contemplative
text: Your brain has evolved psychic defenses. You gain mental resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). Successes on saving throws against mental effects applying the controlled condition become critical successes.

name: Itinerant Scholar Osharu
text: Their love of knowledge makes osharus in high demand as scholars across the galaxy. You become trained in one Lore skill of your choice and in Society, and gain Multilingual as a bonus feat.

name: Ivairan Elf
text: You're descended from ancient elven travelers who toured the galaxy on century-long starship caravans. During daily preparations, you reflect on your travels and gain the Additional Lore feat for a Lore subcategory about a specific place until your next preparations.

name: Izalraan Izalguun
text: Your ancestors left the Scoured Stars before the Gap to escape the influence of the god Kadrical, settling on Izalraan. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage in the brawling group with finesse and unarmed traits.

name: Jeweled Orb Bantrid
text: Your foot orb is a giant shimmering crystal resonating with magic. Choose a magical tradition and gain one cantrip from that tradition's spell list, castable at will as an innate spell heightened to half your level.

name: Jungle Brenneri
text: You hail from the Clorwana jungles on Vanturan. You become trained in Athletics and have a climb Speed of 20 feet.

name: Junker Goblin
text: You use jury-rigged tools and a deceptively clever mind to craft just about anything. You gain an attribute boost to Intelligence instead of Charisma, become trained in Crafting, and gain the Explosive Engineering feat.

name: Jury-Rigging Raxilite
text: You've installed a specialized surgical module to repurpose scrap metal for emergency repairs. You become trained in Crafting or Medicine. Once per day, spend 10 minutes feeding 1 Bulk of scrap metal into your surgical module to regain HP equal to five times your level.

name: Karapentu
text: You bonded with a karapal, a freshwater amphibian from Saaruq-5. You gain a swim Speed equal to your land Speed and the amphibious trait, enabling you to breathe in water and air.

name: Karmic Samsaran
text: Past deeds echo into this life. Once per day, you can ask the GM one yes/no question about an event within the last 100 years; the GM must answer truthfully.

name: Kasath Survivalist Kasatha
text: You and your ancestors chose not to abandon your dying home world. You can Hustle twice as long while exploring, and increase group Hustle time. Gain Feather Step feat.

name: Keen-Sighted Raxilite
text: Your community often worked in shadowy places like tunnels or surface mines, so you were given a visual augmentation at a young age. You gain darkvision.

name: Keen-Sighted Vlaka
text: You have a particularly keen sense of vision, honed through generations of surviving on a world bathed in the dim light of a dying star. You gain darkvision.

name: Korasha Lashunta
text: Adaptive genetics heritage granting a stockier, more muscular build. Gain Strength boost and Wisdom flaw, 8 Hit Points from ancestry, and +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics for Shove or Trip.

name: Krethiskar Cutoff Shirren
text: You were awoken on Krethiskar after centuries of hibernation, resembling the shirren's distant ancestor with a spiked carapace. Gain +2 to Perception for sense motive and cast Command as a 1st-rank innate spell once daily.

name: Krregr-Po Talphi
text: Talphis who become semiprofessional artistic diplomats make beautiful gifts to start relationships. You become trained in Crafting. You can attempt a Crafting check to create a beautiful trinket from readily available materials, and use Crafting instead of Diplomacy to make an impression by giving your target the trinket.

name: Ksarik Leshy
text: Your body is made of plant matter evolved through exposure to psychic energy on Castrovel. You're quadrupedal with vine-like tentacles. Gain an Ancestral Unarmed Attack (tentacle, 1d4 bludgeoning with agile, finesse, grapple, trip, and unarmed traits). Ksariks recognize you as one of their own.

name: Legionnaire Ryphorian
text: Whether born on Triaxus or in a military facility, your family has been part of the Skyfire Legion for generations. This massive mercenary company has been your extended family, and its concepts of honor and brotherhood are foundational to you.

name: Lightning Bug Urog
text: Your crystalline silicon physiology enables you to store more electricity. You gain electricity resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). Additionally, a battery regains 1 charge for every 10 minutes it's in your possession.

name: Lightning Wave Fonqugon
text: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative with Perception and electricity resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). This results from prenatal exposure to electrically charged tidal waves.

name: Lime-Blooded Madrosarai
text: Lime blood is associated with innovation and working with objects. You become trained in Crafting and gain the Quick Repair skill feat.

name: Liminal Ryphorian
text: You were born during the brief spring or autumn seasons of Triaxus's eccentric orbits, demonstrating a blend of both summerborn and winterborn traits. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against cold and fire effects (increasing to +2 at 13th level).

name: Linguist Tengu
text: You are an exceptional mimic. You learn one additional language of your choice and can replicate any accent perfectly.

name: Listener Ysoki
text: Your time near an Iridium Spire opened your mind to the Netherworld and tinged your fur silver or purple. You become trained in Occultism and gain the Listen action.

name: Lithe Nuar
text: Tall but spindly, you move with greater agility. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.

name: Living Codex Barathu
text: You've cataloged all your experiences with other creatures. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to checks to aid on Recall Knowledge and become trained in Society or another skill.

name: Locomotive Bantrid
text: You are exceptionally good at handling the thousands of cilia on the underside of your body. You have a Speed of 30 feet and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to balance and to your Reflex DC to avoid being tripped.

name: Longsnout Ysoki
text: Your family's long snouts grant enhanced smell. You gain imprecise scent with a 30-foot range and a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks when seeking creatures within scent range.

name: Lowcrawler Talphi
text: Your body is stouter than most and you sit uncommonly close to the ground. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your DCs against attempts to shove or trip you, and to saves against effects that knock you prone. You also gain the Feign Prone action.

name: Luckless Worlanisi
text: You are Medium in size with 8 HP from ancestry instead of 6. Your psychic abilities have atrophied — you lack Limited Telepathy and Psychic Reverb. You gain resistance to fire damage equal to half your level (minimum 1).

name: Luminous Woioko
text: Your bioluminescence is vivid. You can shed bright light in a 20-foot radius and gain a +1 to Performance.

name: Lunar Dragon
text:
You are a lunar dragon, descended from a line of nosy interplanetary people watchers. You inherently reflect light, making it easier to avoid being dazzled or blinded. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects that would dazzle or blind you, and if you roll a success on a saving throw against such an effect, you get a critical success instead.

Your associated damage type is cold, your breath shape is a line, and your additional unarmed attacks are tail and horn. You can choose Wisdom instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are arcane.

name: Magic Dabbler Urog
text: You seek to unravel the secrets of magic as though they were a science. You gain the Ancestral Cantrip standardized ancestry feat. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Identify Magic and Learn a Spell.

name: Magic-Sworn Vulkarisu
text: Born with two tails and alabaster fur, you gain one cantrip from the primal spell list and can cast it as an innate primal spell at will, heightened to half your level rounded up.

name: Magma Dragon
text:
You are a magma dragon, descended from a line of brash, unpredictable, and violent fire elemental dragons. You gain the elemental and fire traits, though you still need to breathe. You gain the Draconic Resistance feat as a bonus feat.

While your associated damage type is fire, if you gain a breath weapon, it deals half fire damage and half bludgeoning damage, as you breathe molten magma. Your breath shape is a cone, and your additional unarmed attacks are tail and horn. You can choose Charisma instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are primal.

You gain fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).

name: Magnetic Orb Bantrid
text: You develop a foot orb with a magnetic metallic core, gaining climb speed on metal surfaces and bonuses to Acrobatics and Fortitude defenses.

name: Manifested Contemplative
text: Your brainwaves are so powerful that occult magic manifests at your will. Choose one cantrip from the occult spell list. You can cast this cantrip as an occult innate spell at will, heightened to half your level rounded up.

name: Manufacturer Barathu
text: Your body is a living laboratory. You become trained in Crafting and gain the Serum Crafting feat.

name: Marixan Warhawk Orc
text: You grew up on Marixah at the height of its cold war, training since birth for anticipated conflict. You gain Additional Lore for Warfare Lore. When you Scout, you can roll Warfare Lore instead of Perception for initiative.

name: Massive Novian
text: You were born from a massive star or red supergiant and are much larger than the typical novian. Instead of Tiny, your size is Small. You gain 10 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 6.

name: Matter Eater Urog
text: The cilia covering your body siphon only the molecules you need to live without harming surrounding objects. You can keep yourself fed with any non-living material without the Subsist downtime activity, and gain poison resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).

name: Merchant Witchwyrd
text: Generations of trade sharpen your tongue. You become trained in Diplomacy and gain a +1 to checks to Earn Income.

name: Mercurial Dragonkin
text: You form temporary partner bonds lasting 1 day instead of permanent ones, formed in 10 minutes with reduced Transfer Vitality costs.

name: Merged Barathu
text: A unique entity formed from two or more barathus in constant union. You're Large instead of Medium, gain 10 Hit Points from ancestry instead of 8, and receive +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against emotion effects.

name: Meyel's Chosen Pahtra
text: You possess blessed luck from the goddess Meyel. Once daily, when you critically fail a saving throw, you immediately reroll it as a free action.

name: Mindstatic Orocoran
text: Your mind releases a steady psychic static to scramble incoming mental signals, shielding you from mind control and psychic attacks. You gain the Static Shield reaction.

name: Mire Dweller Osharu
text: The inhabitants of the Mire are hardier than their studious brethren. You become trained in Nature, gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against plant, poison, and wood effects, and succeed on a success against poison becomes a critical success.

name: Mod Fanatic Android
text: You have modified your body to be compatible with armor upgrades. Your body has one armor upgrade slot that doesn't count toward your armor's total upgrades. Choose one common armor upgrade with an item level of 1 or less to begin with.

name: Moon Guard Copaxi
text: You lived on Sabraxid moon, adapted to harsh conditions. You gain 8 ancestry HP and a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against death or void effects.

name: Moonflower Leshy
text: Your body is made from twisting vines with glowing orbs. Your size is Medium instead of Small. You constantly shed bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for the next 20 feet. You can suppress your light by spending one Interact action.

name: Mottled Hide Ijtikri
text: Your home waters teemed with minerals that your mantle absorbed, developing into a thickened shell. You gain 10 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 8 and gain the Diehard general feat.

name: Mutant Goblin
text: A love for radiation means many goblins grow bizarre mutations. You gain the mutant trait. Select one mutation: Bioelectricity, Chromatophores, Extra Limbs, Flight (20 ft), Gills (swim 25 ft), Limited Telepathy, Mutant Magic, or Suckers (climb 20 ft).

name: Nchaki Attendant Shirren
text: Raised in the underground Forever Halls of Liavara's shepherd moon Nchak. You're trained in Diplomacy and can use the aid reaction once per day to help allies without preparation.

name: Nelentu
text: Closely resembling a bat coated in oozing spores, you're a nelentu. You gain a climb Speed equal to your land Speed and don't need any hands free to Climb.

name: Nephilim
text:
A celestial or fiendish influence runs in your bloodline. You gain the nephilim trait, resistance to one energy type tied to your lineage equal to half your level (minimum 1), and access to nephilim ancestry feats.

Pathfinder 2e versatile heritage — not part of Starfinder 2e; check with your GM.

name: Networked Android
text: Your body was modified to network seamlessly with other tech creatures. You gain shortwave, allowing wireless communication within 30 feet with tech constructs. Attempt Computers checks to Hack systems or Disable Devices without a toolkit at 30 feet range.

name: Newborn Ryphorian
text: This heritage arose from cosmic events surrounding the Newborn's birth and Aucturn's destruction, which severed some ryphorians' connections to Triaxus's seasonal cycles. Characters develop enhanced psychic sensitivity to others' emotions. Gain the Sympathetic Bond feat.

name: Next-Gen Raxilite
text: You come from a family that adopted the most avant-garde tech, installing a new IMAS prototype in you as a baby. Your cutting-edge IMAS lets you move faster than most other raxilites. Your Speed is 30 feet.

name: Night-Singer Tripkee
text: Your calls carry power. You can use Performance instead of Intimidation once per day and gain low-light vision as darkvision.

name: Nightmare Dragon
text:
You are a nightmare dragon, descended from a line of artists of terror from the Dreamlands. You gain the dream trait. You are trained in Intimidation (or another skill of your choice if you would already be trained in Intimidation) and gain a +1 circumstance bonus on your checks to Demoralize or Coerce, or a +2 circumstance bonus if you know specifics of a creature's nightmare, such as from the dream sight feat. If you're a master in Intimidation, this increases to a +2 circumstance bonus, or a +3 circumstance bonus if you know specifics of a creature's nightmare.

Your associated damage type is mental, your breath shape is a cone, and your additional unarmed attacks are tail and horn. You can choose Constitution instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are occult.

name: Nightstalker Vesk
text: You've adapted to live in darkness, perhaps living underground, in dim starship corridors, or on a planet far from its sun. You gain darkvision.

name: Nimble Catfolk
text: You always land on your feet. You take no damage from falls of 20 feet or less and reduce longer fall damage by 20 feet.

name: Nocturnal Catfolk
text: Your senses are tuned for the dark. Your low-light vision improves to darkvision.

name: Nomadic Vlaka
text: You live your life on the move, traveling the galaxy in an endless journey. You gain two additional languages of your choice. When you select the Multilingual skill feat, you gain three new languages instead of two.

name: Occult Dragon
text:
You are an occult dragon, or thaumaturge dragon, descended from a line of eclectic seekers who delve into the secrets of esoteric objects and live most of their lives in a humanoid disguise. You gain the Change Shape feat as a bonus feat.

Your associated damage type is your choice of cold or fire, your breath shape is a cone, and your additional unarmed attacks are tail and horn. You can choose Charisma instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are occult.

name: Ocean Diver Barathu
text: You gain underwater breathing, a swim speed equal to your fly speed, and access to the Living Submersible action for exploring oceanic depths.

name: Odd-Horned Nuar
text: Your odd number of horns grow thicker and stronger than most. Your horns unarmed attack gains the deadly d8 trait.

name: Offworld Shobhad
text: You were born offworld, far from shobhad clans and your ancestral home world. You lose the cold adapted ability but gain an additional 1st-level shobhad ancestry feat for which you meet the prerequisites.

name: Oozebonded Pahtra
text: A deep-jungle pahtra bonded with a symbiotic ooze. Gain acid resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1) and +2 circumstance bonus to Reflex saves against being engulfed.

name: Opensky G'folian
text: Your ancestors had a deep connection with the hidden truths of the cosmos. You can cast Detect Magic as a divine innate cantrip at will. You become trained in Religion and gain a +1 bonus to recall knowledge about creatures from other planes.

name: Outworlder Kalo
text: You've spent significant time away from Kalo-Mahoi's oceans, gaining expertise in dry land challenges. Your land Speed increases by 5 feet (to 25 feet for most kalos).

name: Pack-Born Kholo
text: You thrive in groups. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls when flanking.

name: Pampered Ikeshti
text: Your brood was raised in a resource-rich region and you don't gain the wasteland survivor ability. Instead, you gain 10 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 6 and gain the Fast Recovery general feat.

name: Paradise Dragon
text:
You are a paradise dragon, descended from a line of defenders and champions of righteousness. You are resolute against poisons and petrification. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on saving throws against poison or petrification. Each of your successful saving throws against a poison affliction reduces its stage by 2, or by 1 for a virulent poison. Each critical success against an ongoing poison reduces its stage by 3, or by 2 for a virulent poison.

Your associated damage type is force, your breath shape is a line, and your additional unarmed attacks are tail and wing. You can choose Constitution instead of Strength for your first ancestry ability boost. Your spells are divine.

name: Past-Life Samsaran
text: A specific past life's skill surfaces strongly. Choose one skill; you gain expert proficiency in it.

name: Patagi Maraquoi
text: You're descended from ancient maraquoi hunters with specialized membranes spanning from your forearms to your calves. You take no damage from falling and can glide slowly toward the ground, 5 feet down and up to 20 feet forward each round.

name: Petrified Khizar
text: Your body is covered in thick, plated bark that functions as medium armor in the plate armor group (granting +4 item bonus to AC). You can never wear other armor or remove the bark, but can etch armor runes onto it.

name: Pioneer Human
text: Child of explorers or colonists with wanderlust to travel and explore. At 1st level, choose cold or heat for reduced environmental effects. Gain Survival training and Terrain Expertise skill feat.

name: Plague-Hardened Trox
text: You've built up an immunity to the pathogens within the Gretheshe vaults on Nchak. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saves against diseases and gain the Toughness general feat.
